title: Viettel Cyberbot
overview: Enterprise chatbot platform serving banking and financial organizations across multiple communication channels.
challenge: Build a stable and configurable chatbot platform capable of supporting customer service operations, live chat, and real-time messaging under production workloads.
contributions: Developed administration modules for chatbot configuration, analytics, and user management.
Improved backend performance through query optimization and caching strategies across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis.
Maintained real-time communication using Socket.IO and Laravel Echo Server.
Participated in deployment automation, Kubernetes operations, and production troubleshooting.
